steps.title: 📚 Introduction
text: Welcome to the in-depth guide. Here we will explain all features of the app.
Don't forget that you can quit this guide at any time by pressing 'Escape'.

steps.title: 🔝 Top Bar Overview
text: The top bar contains various tools to interact with the app
some of the functions are buttons to save, load, view changelog, access help, and open settings.

steps.title: 💾 Save Button
text: Click the Save button to save your current work.
-Saving can be used to share your generator with friends!
-Or it be used if you have a common usage of this app

steps.title: 📂 Load Button
text: Click the Load button to load previously saved work.
You can also load work shared by your friends at any time!

steps.title: 📝 Rundown Section
text: The rundown section is where you can write words.
Words can either be 'static' words or 'pouch' words
All those words will be compiled together to form the sentence.

steps.title: ✏️ Adding Words
text: In the rundown section, click the + button to add a new word.

steps.title: 🔤 Static and Pouch Words
text: You can add 'static' words or 'pouch' words.
Pouch words start with '@' and create a corresponding pouch in the Pouches list.
For example, typing '@name' creates a pouch called 'name' in the pouches list.

steps.title: 🗂 Pouches List
text: The pouches list on the right is where all your pouches are managed.
Click on a pouch to add, modify, or delete its elements.

steps.title: ✨ Creating Pouches
text: When you add a pouch word in the rundown, a corresponding pouch is automatically created in the pouches list.

steps.title: 🗂 Managing Pouches
text: Click on a pouch to add elements to it. You can also modify or delete elements.

steps.title: ⚡ Generating Sentences
text: Click the Generate button to compile your rundown into a complete sentence.
-Static Words remain intact
-Pouch words are replaced with random elements from their pouches.

steps.title: ❓ Accessing Help
text: If you need help at any point, click the help button on the top bar to access this detailed tutorial.

steps.title: 🚀 Advanced Tips
text: Advanced tip: You can manage multiple pouches and use them creatively to generate complex sentences.

steps.title: 💾 Data Persistence Feature
text: The app's persistence feature ensures that your data is saved automatically, so you don't lose your progress.

steps.title: 🔍 That's all Folks!
text: Feel free to explore and experiment with different words and pouches to see how they interact and generate sentences.
